reviews.text: We can't recommend Jill enough. She is incredibly patient and non-judgemental, which was so reassuring for us. She helped us navigate socialization and all the potential pitfalls of first time ownership with our first dog, Gigi, and has been just as brilliant with Rumi, expertly handling their different personalities.

We’ve been having sessions with Jill since we got our puppy at 4 months old (she’s now 10 months) and she’s absolutely brilliant. She’s knowledgeable and patient and doesn’t make you feel like an idiot for not knowing everything. She also has her own experiences of dogs with challenges and so you feel like it’s normal and you haven’t accidentally adopted Kujo…

Highly recommend her.

The investment that keeps on giving.

Having a couple of 121 sessions with Jill has been a gamechanger. My expectation was we’d hopefully come away with some techniques to manage my puppy’s chasing drive (of cars/cyclists/runners) but I learnt an incredible amount about my dog, his drives (herding behaviour) and how to manage him. I understand him a lot better now which has help build our trust, recall and management.

Jill trained me and not the dog which has really grown my confidence. My stress on walks is so much lower as I feel i’ve got a way to manage and control Rufus now. We’ve also got lots of games to play both as ongoing homework but that also help us bond.

There’s no doubt I’ll be calling on Jill again once Rufus is a little more grown up and if we need any help.
